mechanism_narrative: The sharp rebound in WORKPLACES from -51.7 to -20.6 after t-2w signals a rapid return of daytime foot traffic that feeds retail trips with a 2- to 4-week lag, pushing RETAIL_REC upward relative to the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above the previous 4-week mean within 28 days while WORKPLACES stays near or above its current level.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above +7 while TRANSIT remains below -40, trip-chaining shifts toward neighborhood purchases and errands rather than discretionary shopping, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed over the next 1 to 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -40 and RESIDENTIAL stays above +7 for at least one weekly observation
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises relative to the last 4-week mean despite concurrent high RESIDENTIAL and deeply negative TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week recovery in TRANSIT from below -50 toward -40 indicates easing movement constraints; if that threshold is crossed and sustained, retail visitation follows within 4 weeks and RETAIL_REC increases.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -45 after being below -50 in the prior week
failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses above -45 but RETAIL_REC remains flat or lower than the prior 4-week average over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A positive PARKS shock in warm-weather weeks diverts discretionary outings away from malls and retail strips, so RETAIL_REC falls in the following week when PARKS turns positive after a negative spell.
candidate_trigger: PARKS flips from negative to positive week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in the week after PARKS turns positive and stays positive.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM is near zero or negative while WORKPLACES is still improving, the household stock-up phase has passed and routine commuting dominates, which lifts discretionary retail visits over the next 2 to 4 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 28 days even though WORKPLACES continues to recover and GROCERY_PHARM stays near zero or below.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed drop in WORKPLACES below -30 after a short rebound indicates tightening limits on in-person activity; retail demand follows the same constraint with a 2-week lag, lowering RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -30 after previously being above -25 in the prior week
failure_condition: WORKPLACES drops below -30 but RETAIL_REC does not fall below its prior 4-week average within 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both rise together, people substitute toward local outdoor leisure and home-based activity, which suppresses discretionary retail trips; the effect appears over the next 4 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while both PARKS and RESIDENTIAL remain above their recent weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: In holiday-shopping weeks, a broad improvement in GROCERY_PHARM together with stable or rising TRANSIT signals bundled errand and shopping trips, which should lift RETAIL_REC within 1 week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above 0 after being negative in the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve in the next week after GROCERY_PHARM turns positive and TRANSIT is not worsening.
